description: The sampling family's free shapes against Triton (vLLM branch tilelang-sampling with the sweep knobs) on image -next-4: the greedy partial argmax at 64, 128 and 256 threads a block with a warp or a thread per row in the finish, the select kernel likewise, and temperature at 64, 128 and 256 threads, each first compared with Triton bit for bit, then timed per call; and each production kernel's own device time (CUPTI) against Triton's.
